raw.title: Nirvana
raw.description: Liberation from repeated rebirth in saṃsāra
raw.extract: Nirvana, in the Indian religions, is the concept of an individual's passions being extinguished as the ultimate state of salvation, release, or liberation from suffering (duḥkha) and from the cycle of birth and rebirth (saṃsāra).
